Audi Sport Team Abt Sportsline: Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2000.
Audi Sport Team Rosberg: Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. Has raced Audis since 2006. René Rast won the 2017 and 2019 titles with the team.
Audi Sport Team Phoenix: Founded by Ernst Moser. Based in Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2006.
BMW Team RMG: Stefan Reinhold's team from Andernach. Marco Wittmann won the 2014 and 2016 titles with the team.
BMW Team RBM: Founded by Bart Mampaey. Based in Mechelen, Belgium. Has run BMWs in the DTM since 2012.
BMW Team RMR: A BMW team run jointly by RMG and RBM. Entered since 2017.
Audi Sport Team WRT: Vincent Vosse's team from Belgium. Runs Audis in GT racing. Second DTM season in 2020, with three cars.
Orlen Team ART: Frédéric Vasseur's team from France. Ran Mercedes cars in the DTM in 2004 and 2005. Returns in 2020 with a customer BMW for Robert Kubica.
